critical_code_review_comments: seed_templates.py flushes and continues on per-template failure but on exception it calls db.rollback() while other templates in the SAME session were already flushed — the rollback will roll back everything since the last commit(). In practice the commit() only happens at the end, so a mid-loop failure would silently discard successful earlier iterations. Consider committing after each successful template OR using SAVEPOINT/nested transactions. Non-blocking for current usage (all templates are static and equally valid) but worth a follow-up.
